{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Count QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
total_completed = len(completed_orders)
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter out QA orders
valid_completed = completed_orders[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = valid_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print all required evidence
print(f"total_completed: {total_completed}")
print(f"qa_count: {qa_count}")
print(f"mean_revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
